tools.name: get_assets_list
tools.description: List the active analytics assets, each with its code and name. Use a code as the asset argument of the other tools.

tools.name: get_metrics_list
tools.description: Discover metrics for one asset (BTC by default) by existing category, including honest held and delayed states. tools.name: get_asset_metrics
tools.description: Discover the available and held metrics of one asset. Use it once you know the asset: asset is required, so the answer never falls back to BTC, and its rows are the same as get_metrics_list gives. Each row has the plan its data needs; fetch_metric serves rows whose plan is free.

tools.name: get_metric_metadata
tools.description: Read the current metric definition, supported intervals, method, coverage and source limitations.

tools.name: fetch_metric
tools.description: Read exact unreduced observations of one metric with decimal strings, original source clocks, revision, finality and gaps. End is exclusive. tools.name: fetch_bulk_metrics
tools.description: Read multiple metric selections sequentially. Each item retains its own provenance and revision; this is not one atomic snapshot. Unsupported selections are explicit per-item errors. The existing 200000-observation and response-byte bounds apply to the combined result.
